name: Link in Bio
shortDescription: One page with all your links, a QR code, and a contact card.
description: Makes the page you put in your bio: your picture and name on a card that tilts as you move, over a slowly drifting color field, with every link you share, your social profiles, a QR code that opens the page, and a Save contact button that adds you to a phone's contacts. Press and hold a link on a phone to copy it. Pick from four color themes, and the page follows the visitor's light or dark setting. It is a folder of plain files you can host anywhere.
setup: Your agent asks, in one message, for your name, a one-line intro, a picture of you, the links you want on the page with a short label for each, your social handles, and the web address the page will live at so the QR code opens it. It also asks whether to add a phone number and email to the Save contact card, and which theme you like: dawn, dusk, mono, or candy. No accounts or keys are needed, and everything stays in your project folder.
